connector.name: Credda Trust
connector.registryDescription: Check a counterparty's verifiable Credda trust record; verify or present signed credentials.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the credda-io account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CREDDA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Credda platform API key. Without it the public read/verify tools still work; with it the platform tools (score reads, monitors, usage) are enabled.

env.name: CREDDA_USER_ID
env.description: Optional. The external id this server presents credentials for; needed only by mint_my_trust_token and present_my_credential (with CREDDA_API_KEY).

env.name: CREDDA_API_BASE
env.description: Optional override for the Credda API base URL, e.g. for a staging deployment.
